502:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's wrong, $$マリーダ$$? Are you worried about that bastard $$リディ$$?」

502:t_10:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You address me, your former enemy, with respect, but call your former ally a bastard?」

502:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For a merchant, whether someone benefits us is everything.」

502:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And today, $$マリーダ$$, you're a valued customer who generated 100 Z of $$Ｚチップ$$s by fighting $$リディ$$.」

502:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally, I've added them to the team's stock.」

502:t_10:11.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「When I piloted that mobile suit...the $$バンシィ$$, Master and $$バナージ$$ saved me...」

502:t_10:12.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「So I thought it might be my turn to help him next...」

502:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You were forcibly reconditioned to pilot it, $$マリーダ$$, but that bastard $$リディ$$ chose to do so himself...」

502:t_10:14.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「No, it's the same... He and I...and that man, too. Something has constrained the way all of us live.」

502:t_10:16.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I vaguely remember him. His face, always peering at me with concern...」

502:t_10:17.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「He was different from Master... Yet I felt the same thing from him...」

502:t_10:19.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Maybe that's why... I've always been protected, but I want to try.」

502:t_10:20.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...Still, it may be presumptuous of me to think I can save someone.」

502:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand, $$マリーダ$$. Then you should first make contact with $$リディ$$ and understand how he feels.」

502:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But please be careful. If you become too involved, you will put your life in danger, $$マリーダ$$.」

502:t_10:23.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I'll remember those words.」

502:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good luck, $$マリーダ$$. I look forward to you producing more high-quality $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

502:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're so obviously trying to get rid of me!」

502:t_10:32.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you have business with me, that would be it.」

502:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, it isn't. I have some photographs I'd like you to buy.」

502:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... Ones of you and $$リリーナ$$ that I obtained from a certain source...」

502:t_10:38.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I've already had the original data deleted. I won't let shameless people have private photographs of my sister.」

502:t_10:43.en:
$$刹那$$
「You don't need to worry. Leave the rest to $$ゼクス$$.」

502:t_10:44.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But that leaves the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ without a guide.」

502:t_10:47.en:
$$刹那$$
「Then let's get fired up for another day of...」

502:t_10:49.en:
$n
「...Somehow, it seems I've become the only one who refuses to do that...」

503:t_000:0.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「I've confirmed a force approaching us!」

503:t_001:0.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「You're saying there are only two machines!?」

503:t_001:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Miss $$スメラギ$$ has a mean streak.」

503:t_001:3.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Now I truly understand what she meant when she said only idiots could carry out this operation.」

503:t_002:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「He's already lived up to expectations. Then...」

503:t_003:0.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Nearly half our forces are gone in an instant...!」

503:t_003:1.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Impossible! Even with overwhelming firepower, how could he charge in alone!?」

503:t_003:2.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「We can't maintain our formation like this!」

503:t_003:3.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Intercept them! We can't let a mere advance force do as it pleases any longer!」

503:t_003:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「It's no wonder they're confused. They probably think charging into a situation we know is a trap is madness.」

503:t_003:5.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But idiots can do it. And by doing so, they create an opening.」

503:t_003:7.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I don't intend to die before we save $$リリーナ$$.」

503:t_003:8.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「It's only a foolish man's life! I have no regrets about using it for my sister!」

503:t_004:0.en:
$$グエン$$
「He's quite capable. That is what one expects of a $$ガンダム$$.」

503:t_004:1.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「I don't like this. I want to go out there and pluck those white wings off him.」

503:t_004:2.en:
$$グエン$$
「White isn't the only color a $$ガンダム$$ comes in.」

503:t_004:4.en:
$$グエン$$
「Now...how will the queen's fate turn out...?」

503:t_005:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The timing is perfect. Our main force has arrived, too.」

503:t_006:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「The mission is not yet complete.」

503:t_006:2.en:
$$デュオ$$
「In other words, you don't intend to die before rescuing the young lady.」

503:t_006:3.en:
$n
「It seems $$クロノ$$ isn't using Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン#relena$$ as a hostage.」

503:t_006:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Could the information that she was captured have been false in the first place?」

503:t_006:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Based on everything so far, I don't believe $$クィーン$$ would feed us false information.」

503:t_006:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Let's discuss that later...! Their main force is coming out!」

503:t_007:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I see! With this much firepower, they don't need a hostage!」

503:t_007:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Then I'll deal with them quickly.」
